title: Rapid Acting Treatment = Better Compliance
subtitle: Matt Tucker From Nightware explains things that matter
body_html:
This one is quick. The Frontier Psychiatrists hosted its first in person event this week. Matt Tucker is a relentless entrepreneur and one of the team members at Nightware, Grady Hannah, the CEO of which, really pushed me to get this done.
